name: Stainless steels
description: Conventional (ingot) stainless steels with enough free chromium, roughly 12% or more, to resist rust in everyday use.

name: Powder metallurgy stainless steels
description: Stainless steels made by powder metallurgy, which keeps carbides small and evenly spread so high-alloy steels stay tough enough for knives.

name: Tool steels
description: Ingot tool steels designed for dies and cutting tools; high wear resistance, limited corrosion resistance.

name: Powder metallurgy tool steels
description: Powder metallurgy tool steels that combine high toughness with wear resistance, with little corrosion resistance.

name: High-speed powder steels
description: Powder metallurgy high-speed steels with tungsten, molybdenum and vanadium; very high hardness and edge retention, low corrosion resistance.

name: Carbon steels
description: Simple carbon and low-alloy steels: easy to sharpen and often tough, but they rust and patina without care.
